notes.content:

Chapter 1:

notes.title: Release notes for DEMO 1.1v
notes.content:
General:
[list]
[*] Fixed graphical errors.
[*] Fixed translation errors.
[*] Fixed collisions in various maps.
[*] Fixed behavior of 'Puretia' skill events. Dried roots and rotten nuts now reflect the correct state after a successful input.
[*] Updated .webm files.
[*] Adjusted skill priorities for various enemies.
[*] HOTFIX: Fixed translation error at the end of the demo and the save screen.
[/list]
Chapter 1:
[list]
[*] Leafko can now get the Orange even without money.
[*] Fertile learns 'Cultivate' at level 10.
[*] Mold's 'Drain' skill has been nerfed.
[*] The Master Key Chest in 'Buried Mansion' no longer removes the 'Combination' item.
[*] Fixed Daphne's Garden events that prevented harvesting the green and yellow flowers.
[*] Fixed Chapter 1 Ending FMV event that soft-locked the game when returning to the Citadel after starting Chapter 2.
[/list]
Chapter 2:
[list]
[*] Fixed Maizé animations in 'Mazorca Farm.'
[*] Added animated sprites of 'Colorful Corn' item.
[*] Fixed Aloe Priestess event that allowed donations without money.
[*] Added a tile to prevent skipping the addition of Encinia in Aloe.
[*] Fixed Encinia vent events that relocated Leafko’s position.
[*] Encinia cannot regroup with Leafko if she doesn't obtain 'Master Credentials' in 'Ancient Factory.'
[*]Fixed movable pot in 'Ancient Factory - Office.'
[*] Fixed 'DECE' miniboss' forced skill if defeating 'ACE' first.
[*] Fixed NPCs dialogues after finishing 'Ancient Factory.'
[*] North Citadel Gate is now locked after the Chapter 2 Ending.
[*] Fixed Leafko transparency after finishing the demo.
[*] Fixed Mauricio's movement in 'Secret Mauricio Cabin' that soft-locked the game.
[/list]
